title: Grateful Dead Live at Unknown or Various on 1968-12-31
lineage: 5 Vault reels> 4 CDs- see info file for available details

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard compilation with high‑energy early jams – standout Alligator‑Drums‑Caution segment and multiple brilliant St. Stephen excerpts.
ai_review.review: The collection pulls together several mysterious 1968‑69 tapes, delivering crystal‑clear SBD audio that captures the band at a peak of improvisational fire. Reviewers rave about the legendary Alligator > drums > caution jam, the various “St. Stephen” performances and the raw power of Pigpen’s early contributions, while noting only minor cut‑offs in the longest jams.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars and emphasize superb musical moments and high‑quality soundboard audio; only a few critical comments exist.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp SBD capture with excellent fidelity. A few reviewers note the infamous cut‑off before the end of the Alligator‑Caution jam, but overall the mix is balanced and very listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A seamless compilation of early‑year tapes that weaves together jams, Crypticals and St. Stephens; reviewers praise the flow as “almost too good to be true.”

band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an extended bass solo (the so‑called “Thirteen Jams”/New Potato Caboose segment) that runs to the end of the track.
band_member_comments.Drums: Alligator > drums jam praised as one of the best drum moments ever recorded.
